sources.description: Monitoring alerts raised against queue consumer objectives.
Release and configuration-change events recorded by the delivery pipeline.
Consumer log excerpts retained for the incident window.
Numeric series exported for the incident window, subject to retention.
Responder messages from the incident channel.
Ticket activity linked to the incident.

records.title: notification-consumer lag above objective
records.body: Alert notification-consumer-lag fired at 14:41:30Z. Consumer group notify-workers reported 412000 undelivered messages against an objective of 5000. Alert cleared at 17:12:04Z.

records.title: queue broker retention configuration change
records.body: Configuration change applied at 14:38:00Z, three minutes and thirty seconds before alert-9012. Broker topic notification-events retention raised from 24h to 72h. This change affects on-disk retention only. It does not alter consumer concurrency, acknowledgement behaviour, or delivery order.

records.title: notification-consumer release 4.19.0
records.body: Release 4.19.0 of notification-consumer deployed at 11:02:00Z on 2026-06-01, twenty-seven hours before the incident. Adds a new template renderer that raises TemplateRenderError on a payload whose locale field is absent.

records.title: consumer crash loop begins
records.body: notification-consumer worker-3: TemplateRenderError: missing required field 'locale' while rendering template order_shipped. Worker exited non-zero and was restarted by the supervisor. First occurrence 14:39:12Z.

records.title: same message redelivered repeatedly
records.body: notification-consumer: message 8831f4 redelivered 214 times between 14:39:12Z and 14:52:00Z, each attempt ending in TemplateRenderError. The consumer group makes no forward progress while this message is at the head of its partition. No dead-letter destination is configured for topic notification-events.

records.title: offending message skipped
records.body: notification-consumer: operator advanced the committed offset past message 8831f4 at 17:09:40Z. Consumers resumed forward progress; backlog drained to below objective by 17:12:04Z.

records.title: consumer lag series, retained window only
records.body: Series notify_workers_consumer_lag is retained for 90 minutes at full resolution. Values are available from 16:00:00Z onward and show lag falling from 402000 to 3100 between 17:09:40Z and 17:12:04Z. No retained samples exist before 16:00:00Z, so the rate of backlog growth between 14:39Z and 16:00Z cannot be read from this series.

records.title: responder attributes backlog to the retention change
records.body: Responder D: 'Retention on notification-events was changed three minutes before the alert. Let us revert that first, it is the only thing that changed today.'

records.title: responder proposes scaling consumers
records.body: Responder E: 'Retention is a disk setting, it cannot cause lag. The consumers are just under-provisioned for the volume. I am scaling notify-workers from 6 to 24 replicas.'

records.title: scaling had no effect
records.body: Responder E: 'Scaling to 24 replicas made no difference, lag is still climbing. Every worker is crash-looping on the same TemplateRenderError for message 8831f4.'

records.title: open question about payload origin
records.body: Responder F: 'We skipped message 8831f4, but we never established which producer emitted an order_shipped payload without a locale field. Nobody has checked whether more of them are queued behind this.'

records.title: INC-8815 opened
records.body: INC-8815 opened at 14:44:00Z, severity 2, title 'Notification delivery delayed'. The ticket records no estimate of how many customer notifications were delayed or dropped, and no such estimate was added before resolution.
